name: MT-Sec
description: MT-Sec is the first benchmark to evaluate both correctness and security in multi-turn code generation scenarios, reflecting real-world iterative coding workflows. It transforms single-turn tasks into multi-turn sequences and assesses models on full-program and code-diff generation.
reputation: A new benchmark with limited but growing visibility in code-generation research, especially for iterative and security-aware coding evaluation.
notes: Highlights performance drops from single-turn to multi-turn and trade-offs between correctness and security.
